items.t: Citigroup (C) Explores Venezuela Banking Return As It Seeks Sanctions Waivers
items.sum: Citigroup (NYSE:C) is in talks with U.S. officials about resuming banking services in Venezuela after a five year hiatus. The bank is exploring potential sanctions waivers that would be required before offering services to clients in the Venezuelan market.
